source_title: wetten.overheid.nl BWBV0003138 Verdrag Nederland-Azerbeidzjan (English authentic text, with Protocol)

rates.quote: b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties paid in respect of any patent, design or model, plan, secret formula or process or information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience, if this patent, design or model, plan, secret formula or process or this information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience is not older than 3 years;
b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties in all other cases.

ppt.quote: Pursuant to Article 7(17)(a) of the Convention, the Republic of Azerbaijan considers that the following agreements are not subject to a reservation under Article 7(15)(b) and contain a provision described in Article 7(2). ... 32 Netherlands Articles 11(9), 12(8) and 21(3)

notes: valid_from per Art. 31: provisions have effect for taxable years and periods beginning on or after 1 January of the calendar year following EIF (18.12.2009 -> 01.01.2010); the treaty has no separate withholding-tax effective-date rule. Dividend 5% tier requires direct holding of >=25% of capital AND an investment of at least EUR 200,000 in the payer's capital. Interest: Art. 11(3) exclusive residence taxation where payer or recipient is a Government/public body/subdivision/Central Bank, for Government-approved loans, loans granted/guaranteed/insured by Government, Central Bank or Government-owned agencies (Protocol XI: incl. FMO, NIO, State Oil Fund of Azerbaijan), and credit sales of equipment/construction of installations and public works - not modelled. Royalty 5% tier: patents, designs/models, plans, secret formulas/processes and know-how not older than 3 years; 10% otherwise (incl. copyright, software, trademarks). Protocol IX: refund claims within 5 years. Existing anti-abuse clauses Arts. 11(9), 12(8), 21(3) superseded/replaced by MLI Art. 7(1) PPT (MLI covered by both; WHT effect 2025-01-01 per pair metadata, MLI in force for Azerbaijan 1 Jan 2025). The wetten.overheid.nl text does not incorporate the MLI; no NL synthesised text was read. MLI Art. 8 not applicable (Azerbaijan reserved).
